title: #ScreenshotSaturday – 7 days into building Budapest for my car combat game (Unity + AI)
author: Dense-Bar-2341
selftext:
I've been building a Budapest racing track for BRUTAL DERBY for about a week.

Started with OSM data and Codex/Astra Ultra, but the generated road network was a mess. 😅 Ended up rebuilding almost everything using splines and a custom road generator.

For assets, I use Meshy and Tripo first (1–2 minutes per generation). If both fail after a few attempts, I try Astra (1–2 hours). Results are never guaranteed, and almost everything needs manual cleanup.

Lots of manual placement, barriers, props, and optimization work too.

Music is made with Suno using custom lyrics.

Still very much WIP! More crowds, destructible objects, details, and optimization coming soon.

And yes, it's running in the Unity Editor, hence the FPS. 😄
